# westoldturkic fixtures

Retrieved 2026-09-29 from Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7893910 (v2.0,
license cc-by-4.0 on the record): the LoanpyDataHub CLDF derivation
of Róna-Tas & Berta, West Old Turkic (2011). Real trims of the
extracted cldf/ tables:

- `cldf/languages.csv` — whole (6 lines: the five varieties).
- `cldf/forms.csv` — header + the 8 rows of two complete concepts
  (0_carpenter: H/EAH/WOT · 1_cannoncatapult: all five varieties).
- `cldf/parameters.csv` / `cldf/borrowings.csv` — head -3 each
  (the two fixture concepts' rows).

Pinned truths: EAH/LAH carry no ISO code (upstream ID rides
lang_code verbatim); borrowings target EAH forms (the loan step);
the H rows carry first-attestation Years (1222 for ács).
